sources.title: Piracy monthly report February 2025
sources.text: Duty crew onboard a bulk carrier underway spotted six robbers armed with a hammer in the engine room workshop. Alarm raised, crew mustered and a search was conducted. Incident reported to Singapore Coast Guard who then escorted the vessel. All crew safe and nothing reported stolen.
